name: Nina von Rickenstein
original_name: ニーナ ・ フォン・リッケンシュタイン
source: Tadayoshi's friend and penpal he met in Germany. His fiancée from his time as an heir to Kurokawa Zaibatsu. She is the only one who still remembers Tadayoshi from his past.
